functions.name: IsFullUpdate
functions.docs: Whether all tags should be calculated, as set by the creator of the context (e.g. SavePackage).

functions.name: IsSaving
functions.docs: Whether the call is coming from SavePackage. See functions below for determining what kind of save.

functions.name: IsProceduralSave
functions.docs:
Return whether the package is being saved due to a procedural save. False if not saving.
Any save without the possibility of user-generated edits to the package is a procedural save (Cooking, EditorDomain).
This allows us to add or update tags that only need to be modified in response to new user data.

functions.name: IsCooking
functions.docs: Report whether this is a save into a target-specific cooked format. False if not saving.

functions.name: GetTargetPlatform
functions.docs: Return the targetplatform of the save, if cooking. Null if not saving or not cooking.

functions.name: IsCookByTheBook
functions.docs:
If IsCooking is true, reports whether the cook is CookByTheBook. @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext.
If IsCooking is false, returns false.

functions.name: IsCookOnTheFly
functions.docs:
If IsCooking is true, reports whether the cook is CookByTheBook. @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext.
If IsCooking is false, returns false.

functions.name: IsCookTypeUnknown
functions.docs:
If IsCooking is true, reports whether the cook type is unknown and could be any type of cook.
If IsCooking is false, returns true.

functions.name: GetCookType
functions.docs:
If IsCooking is true, returns the cook type, @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext.
If IsCooking is false, returns ECookType::Unknown.

functions.name: GetCookingDLC
functions.docs:
If IsCooking is true, returns whether whether the cook is for a DLC rather than base game.
If IsCooking is false, returns ECookingDLC::Unknown.

functions.name: FindOrAddTag
functions.signature: FindOrAddTag(Target, Tag Name, Out Already Exists)
functions.docs:
Output function: Add a tag if it does not already exist. Return reference to the existing tag and optionally
report whether it already existed. Issues an error and returns referenced to unused global if TagName is invalid.

functions.name: FindTag
functions.docs: Output function: Find a tag in the output if it already exists. Issues an error if TagName is invalid.

functions.name: ContainsTag
functions.docs: Output function: Report whether a tag is already in the output. Issues an error if TagName is invalid.

functions.name: AddTag
functions.docs: Output function: move the given tag into the results, overwriting previous result if it exists.

functions.name: GetNumTags
functions.docs: Return the number of tags so far reported to the context, including CookTags.

functions.name: EnumerateTags
functions.docs: Pass each tag so far reported to the context into the provided Visitor, including CookTags.

functions.name: WantsBundleResult
functions.docs:
True if the caller wants the FAssetBundleData structure (if present) to be stored as a pointer.
If false, the FAssetBundleData structure should instead be converted to text and stored as a tag.

functions.name: WantsCookTags
functions.docs:
Return whether the context is collecting cook tags. CookTag functions are noops if this returns
false. CookTags are only collected for CookByTheBook.

functions.name: FindOrAddCookTag
functions.signature: FindOrAddCookTag(Target, Tag Name, Out Already Exists)
functions.docs: FindOrAddCookTag but for a cooktag. @see FindOrAddTag and @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext

functions.name: FindCookTag
functions.docs: FindTag but for a cooktag. @see FindTag and @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext

functions.name: ContainsCookTag
functions.docs: ContainsTag but for a cooktag. @see ContainsTag and @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext

functions.name: AddCookTag
functions.docs: AddTag but for a cooktag. @see AddTag and @see FAssetRegistryTagsContext
